qualityRule: No setting-out result is enabled unless the selected installation detail defines the opening allowance and position used by the calculator.

settingOutPolicy.datum: bottom of nominal duct / nominal damper size AFFL
settingOutPolicy.centredOpening: For Lindab methods whose tested drawing gives total opening allowance about the nominal damper, structural opening bottom = nominal duct bottom - half the total height allowance.
settingOutPolicy.noGuess: Methods without a complete documented opening-position chain remain locked.

WK25.settingOut: centred on selected minimum/recommended tested opening
WK25.supports: damper weight and connected ductwork independently supported; remote methods retain method-specific suspension notes

WK25.openingDatum: The published B/H opening dimensions are the structural D-hole. Plasterboard/calcium-silicate strips and rock-wool or mortar sealing are installed inside that D-hole; no separate finished clear-opening dimension is published.
WK25.singleDamperVerification: Supported single-damper methods return a verified structural D-hole, a no-separate-finished-opening status, and centred builder setting-out from the selected allowance.

WK45.supports: damper weight and connected ductwork independently supported
WK45.pairing: maximum two; 200 mm between paired installations where stated

WKS25.fixings: factory fixing flaps raised and used as shown
WKS25.pairing: maximum two; no three; prohibited vertical-axis arrangement retained

auditNote: FNC1, WH25, WH45, WK25, WK45 and WKS25 supported method records audited against the manufacturer booklets. WK25 single-damper D-hole semantics and verification are explicitly mapped. FNC1U remains locked because only a datasheet is available.
documentAccess: Official manufacturer links only; no manufacturer manuals, spreadsheets, drawings or photographs are bundled in the public release.
